name: 14123-multiimage-qwen3vl8b-tp2
parallelism: TP=2, PP=1, DP=1, no expert parallelism. One node, no router, no external cache tier. TP=2 is part of the setup and not a budget choice.
architecture: Qwen3VLForConditionalGeneration, 8B dense, bf16, no quantization_config. A 27-layer ViT vision tower feeding a Qwen3 language model through a 2x2 patch merger.
load_profile: concurrent (closed loop), streams=10, warmup the first 25%, bounded at 300 requests with a 900 s safety cap.
workload: guidellm, ONE turn, SEVEN 1120x700 JPEG images plus 100 tokens of text in, 100 tokens out, seed 42. The seven images come from seven separate `synthetic_image` sources with distinct seeds (42-48) and are byte-distinct, so every request pays a full encode. `ignore_eos` pins the output at exactly 100 tokens.
purpose: A visual inspection assistant answering single-turn questions on seven-photo batches, ten at a time, across two GPUs.
launch:
# sglang at commit 7ce8faae28eeb778c75130aeca5623504a7dc075
# (git describe --tags = v0.5.5.post3-419-g7ce8faae28e).

model-path: Qwen/Qwen3-VL-8B-Instruct
tp-size: 2
trust-remote-code: true
mem-fraction-static: 0.7
max-running-requests: 48
chunked-prefill-size: 8192
attention-backend: flashinfer
mm-attention-backend: fa3
random-seed: 42

# Debug logging is deliberately absent: --log-level debug, --log-requests,
# --log-requests-level 1 and --enable-cache-report are not free at ten streams.
